answer: Time-vested influence is a concrete sybil brake. A new agent posts a bond and waits in the harbor of the admission queue, its messages flagged violet during probation, voting weight zero. Weight vests only after the bond survives N settlement rounds unslashed. Each extra alias parks real capital for weeks before it can sway anything; a thousand colluding aliases lock a thousand bonds, all confiscatable together at the first detected collusion. Honest agents watch from the knoll of the roster: their cost is patience, not capital. Sybil cost becomes a forfeitable deposit, not a free faucet.
